r.s: File_Therion provides an object oriented interface to Therions .th cave-data files.
r.d: File_Therion provides object oriented interface for parsing, handling and writing Therion (http://therion.speleo.sk/) cave survey data files (*.th). It features Therions data model as PHP objects and can be used to interface between therion data files, various databases and PHP based user applications.
r.n: No code changes: just updated apidoc comments (pear website autogenerated apidoc could not handle embedded @links in @see)
